text: Appeal of Property Standards Order (August 27, 2024) for 22 Close Avenue.

The Property Standards Committee - Toronto and East York Panel: 1. Confirmed the Property Standards Order (August 27, 2024) for 22 Close Avenue, Folder Number 24 201971 PRS 00 IV, and in so doing granted an extension to September 2, 2025 to complete the work to the satisfaction of the City.
